senses.gloss: m. (שָׁקַף I, v. מַשְׁקוֹף) cross-piece, lintel, arch, arched gateway with posts.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 12:4">Neg. XII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:5">Tosef. ib. VI, 5</cite> <he>כדי ליתן תחת הש׳</he> as much wood as is required to place under an arch (to keep it in shape); <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:5">Ib.</cite> <he>כדי לעשות סנדל לאחורי הש׳</he> as much as is required to make ‘a shoe’ (protection) back of the arch.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 7:10">Tosef. Ohol. VII, 10</cite> <he>שְׁקוֹפָהּ של מערה</he> the arched entrance of a cave.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 7:10">Ib.</cite> <he>פיה לש׳ וכ׳</he> [<he>בין</he>] <he>אם אין</he> if there is not the space of a handbreadth between the mouth of the pot and the lintel.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:17">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הגביה … את הש׳ וכ׳</he> the angel raised the lintel for him (Phinehas), so that both of them could be seen from between his shoulders; (Bab.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82b:2">ib. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>המשקוף</he>); <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>פתח ש׳</he> (read: <he>את הש׳</he>); (<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>, end <he>המשקוף</he>; Tanḥ. Balak 21 <he>משקוף הבית</he>). Y. Naz. V, 56ᶜ bot. <he>תחת מעי הש׳</he> (strike out <he>מעי</he>, a dittography from preceding clause) under the archway.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:2:3">Y. Nidd. II, 49ᵈ</cite> bot. standing <he>אחר הש׳</he> behind the post (ready to go out); (Bab.

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:3">Midd. II, 3</cite> <he>כל השערים … להן ש׳ וכ׳</he> all the gates that were there (on the Temple mount) had arches with posts, except the gate of T. where there were only two stones leaning one on the other.
